reviews.review_text:
Brent
Port Coquitlam, Canada152 contributions
1
Not very legendary
Sep 2019 • Couples
This place is on many travel lists of must see places in Hanoi. The best thing about this place is the view from the patio. The patio is a wrap around deck with a great view of the lake and traffic circle. The patio is very narrow on the lake side with room for only a small table. In total the patio probably only seats 20 or so people. This place is more of a restaurant than a beer place. They actually only have a few beers to choose from. Prices are a little on the higher side compared to smaller shops but you’re paying for the view. They do have a buy two get one free during happy hour. 3 beers ( 1/2 litre ) was 160k dong. The lager was ok. Beers weren’t very cold but that’s nothing really new in these parts. We did go on a Monday afternoon so the place wasn’t to lively, I’m sure on the weekend there might be a little more action.
